obligations.title: Complete knowledge transition and deliver transition report by 12 March 2026.
Begin steady-state operations with service level reporting by 21 April 2026.
Deliver written benchmarking report and hold review meeting by 21 January 2027.
Provide periodic reporting on the Services.
Report regularly on progress, service level performance and risks.
Appoint a service delivery manager as principal contact.
Appoint a contract manager with day-to-day decision authority.
Comply with the Customer's notified site and security policies.
Hold regular governance meetings to review progress, performance and risks.
Notify Customer in writing on completing each milestone and submit deliverables.
Review deliverables promptly and accept in writing or notify non-conformities.
Correct non-conformities promptly and resubmit deliverables.
Maintain appropriate technical and organisational security measures for personal data.
